name: Gringo's Tacoria
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Gringo’s Tacoria in Tirol!** Discover the vibrant flavors of Mexico and the breathtaking landscapes of **Tirol** in one unforgettable experience. Whether you're craving authentic **Tacos**, smoky **BBQ**, or a refreshing **Margarita**, our menu brings the sun-soaked tastes of Mexico right to your table. **Innsbruck** and the surrounding regions offer the perfect backdrop for your culinary adventure. After feasting on our delicious dishes, explore the stunning **Alps**, charming villages, and world-class outdoor activities—all just a short drive away. Come taste the passion of **Tacoria** in the heart of **Tirol**! 🌮⛰️ --- **

Our Highlights

** - **Handmade Tortillas** – Fresh and crispy, just like Abuela used to make. - **Signature Dishes** – From **Al Pastor** to **Carne Asada**, every bite is a fiesta. - **Vegetarian & Vegan Options** – Because everyone deserves a taste of Mexico! - **Local Craft Beers & Tequilas** – Pair your meal with the finest **Tiroler** brews and smoky **Mezcal**. --- **

Special Events

** 🎉 **Fiesta Nights** – Live music, dancing, and happy hour deals every Friday! 🍽️ **Taco Tuesdays** – All-you-can-eat tacos for a limited time—don’t miss out! 🍹 **Margarita Mondays** – Sip on our famous **Margaritas** with a view of the **Nordkette**. --- **
